name: dsh-plantuml
description: Render PlantUML code blocks in DeepSeek Harness with a Host command, JAR, or PlantUML server.

scripts.check: node scripts/build-client.js --check && node --check src/host/index.js && node --check src/host/renderer.js && node --check dist/client.js && node --test
scripts.pack:local: npm run build:client && npm pack --pack-destination dist
